Ahead of her Make Debut, Grass Wonder 
takes part in a mock race and delivers an 
overwhelmingly dominant performance.

Her running was reminiscent of the 
"Monster" Maruzensky, quickly becoming a 
hot topic of conversation among the 
reporters.

Being compared to Maruzensky renewed her 
determination to surpass the "Monster" and 
reach the absolute pinnacle without fail.
